blocks.text: Introduction: To become a member of a family, you are either born or adopted into it. The new birth is the way you are both born and adopted into the family of God. It is a spiritual experience that transforms you from the kingdom of darkness into the kingdom of God. It is both a spiritual and moral change. Christ lives in you by the Holy Spirit. It is so vital an experience that no one can enter into God's Kingdom without it. {{jo 1:12,jo 1:13|John 1:12-13}}; Gal. 4-5, {{eph 5:30,eph 5:31,eph 5:32|Eph. 5:30-32}}

cards.heading: 1. Understanding the fall of man through Adam

blocks.text: Adam was the head of the human race. Just as the head of a country can cause his country to fall or succeed through his leadership, Adam changed the course of human race by falling into sin. {{rm 5:12|Rom. 5:12}} Satan deceived Adam Gen: 2:15-20, 3:18

cards.heading: 2. Understanding the Consequences of the fall!

items: Loss of communion and fellowship with God {{is 59:2|Isaiah 59:2}}, Ehp.2:11-12
Spiritual Death: Rom.6:23a; Physical Death: Heb.9:27 Eternal Death: {{re 20:15|Rev. 20:15}}
Received the nature of sin and debt to sin.Gen.1:27, 5:3
Transferred our fatherhood to the devil {{jo 8:44|JOHN 8:44}}
Slavery to Satan. Col.1:13, IITim.2:26
Loss of God given authority to the devil {{jo 14:30|JOHN 14:30}}, {{lk 4:5,lk 4:6|Luke 4:5-6}}, {{eph 6:10,eph 6:11,eph 6:12,eph 6:13,eph 6:14,eph 6:15,eph 6:16,eph 6:17,eph 6:18|Eph. 6:10-18}}
Loss of Dominion over all of God's hand work Gen: 1:28
Loss of freedom from disease, sorrow, hardship and sufferings {{gn 3:16,gn 3:17,gn 3:18,gn 3:19|Gen. 3:16-19}}

cards.heading: 3. Undeniable Mercy and Pardon for sin

blocks.text: Some attributes of God: Righteousness 119:137-138, {{jr 23:6|Jer. 23:6}} Just: {{dt 32:4|Deut. 32:4}} ISA.45:21 Love: John: 3:16, {{rm 1:8|Rom 1:8}} Truth: II Sam.7:28, Eternal Life: {{re 1:8|Rev. 1:8}}

To meet God's holy character of justice (for sin) and love (for the sinful man), the last Adam was sent to break down the barrier between God and Man. {{rm 5:17,rm 5:18,rm 5:19|Rom. 5:17-19}}, {{1co 15:21,1co 15:22,1co 15:45,1co 15:46,1co 15:47|I Cor. 15:21-22, 45-47}}

cards.heading: 5. What the New Birth is not

items: Being religious or churchy - {{act 10:1,act 10:2,act 10:3,act 10:4,act 10:5,act 10:6,act 10:7,act 10:8,act 10:9|Acts 10: 1-9}}
Being Self-righteous - Is. 64:6; {{ph 3:8,ph 3:9|Phil. 3:8-9}}
Water Baptism - {{act 8:36,act 8:37,act 8:38,act 8:39|Acts 8:36-39}}

blocks.text: f. Good works and good morals - Is. 64:6; {{act 10:1,act 10:2,act 10:22|Acts 10: 1-2, 22}}
These things are good and important but they will not substitute for the new birth ({{mt 23:23|Matt. 23: 23}})

cards.heading: 6. What is the New Birth? - Part 1 of 2

items: It is a spiritual birth {{jo 3:1,jo 3:2,jo 3:3,jo 3:4,jo 3:5,jo 3:6,jo 3:7|Jn. 3:1-7}}. Our spirit, not flesh becomes born again.
It is the quickening of our spirit that was dead to sin by the word of God {{jo 1:12,jo 1:13|Jn 1:12-13}}; {{1pe 1:23|1 Peter 1:23}}.
It is the process of being translated from darkness into light. {{cl 1:12,cl 1:13|Col. 1:12-13}}; {{eph 2:8,eph 2:9,eph 2:10|Eph. 2:8-10}}
It is the process of substituting the Adamic nature i.e. the sinful nature, to the nature of God (Holiness)

blocks.text: 7. Why is the New Birth So Important? The human nature in any human being will stand against him or her at the gate of heaven if not substituted or exchanged for a Godly nature The natural Man is spiritually dead and cannot obey, understand or please God. {{rm 8:6,rm 8:7,rm 8:8|Rom. 8:6-8}}; {{jr 17:9|Jer. 17:9}}; {{eph 2:3|Eph. 2:3}} The new birth gives eternal life. {{jo 3:16|John 3:16}}. He must be re-born if he is to "see" or "enter" the kingdom of God. {{1jo 3:3|1 John 3: 3}}- The natural man is on a sloppy course to destruction {{prv 14:12,prv 12:15|Prov. 14:12, 12:15}} The new birth guarantee that our name is written in God's book of life Rev.20:15 Without the new birth the natural man is the child of the devil. In 8:44; 1 In 3:10 The natural man is corrupt in his affections and perverse in his will. {{gl 5:19|Gal. 5:19}}; {{mk 7:21,mk 7:22,mk 7:23|Mk 7:21-23}} The new birth affects our taste, habit, opinion, desire, vocabulary appearance and hope etc. {{2co 5:1|2 Cor. 5:1}} 7 Through the new birth, we are raised from death of sin to the life of righteousness

8. How Can I be born again? Acknowledge that you are a sinner - {{rm 3:23|Rom. 3:23}}; {{lk 18:13|Luke 18:13}}; Ps. 51 Sincerely repent of your sins - {{act 3:19|Acts 3:19}}; {{lk 13:3|Luke 13:3}}Confess your sins to God - 1 John: 1:19 or turn away from your sins and old ways - Is. 55:7; {{prv 28:13|Prov. 28:13}} Believe Him and His substitutionary sacrifice - {{jo 3:16|John 3:16}}; {{2co 5:21|II Cor. 5:21}} Receive Him into your heart by faith and thereafter thank God for saving you -{{jo 1:11,jo 1:12|John 1:11-12}}; {{eph 2:8|Eph. 2:8}}

cards.heading: 6. What is the New Birth? - Part 2 of 2

items: What are the Evidences of the New Birth? The following characteristics will be manifested in the believer who is born again: Discuss noticeable evidences of the new birth in your life since you openly confessed Jesus Christ as your Lord and savior
A changed life - {{2co 5:17|II Cor 5:17}} {{cl 3:1,cl 3:2,cl 3:3|Col. 3: 1-3}}
A Righteous and Holy life - {{1jo 2:29,1jo 3:7,1jo 5:18|I John 2:29, 3:7, 5:18}} 1Peter 1: 14-16
Overcoming life - {{1jo 5:4|I John 5:4}}
Power to life the Christian life {{jo 1:12|John 1:12}}
Communion and fellowship with God. {{1jo 1:3|1 John 1:3}}
Godly fear {{ec 12:13|Eccl. 12:13}}
Godly love - {{1jo 4:7|I John 4:7}}
Witness of the spirit - {{rm 8:16|Rom 8:16}}
How Can We Live this New Life Successfully?
By giving ourselves to the study of the Word {{1pe 2:2|I Peter 2:2}}, {{ps 119:103|Ps. 119:103}}
By giving ourselves to Prayer I Thes. 5: 17
We must also submit totally to Christ. {{jm 4:6,jm 4:7|James 4: 6-7}}
by fellowshipping constantly with the brethren. {{hb 10:25|Heb 10: 25}}

conclusion.text: A born again Christian must be different from those who are not. This should be evident in the words, thoughts and actions (what you wear, hear, see or touch) of the believer. Also he or she must let go off old patterns of sins and do away with every form of destructive relationships and ways.
